description: Component C (PLAN.md §5): 10 scripted change requests against the planted SRS (component A, labels.csv). Owners and protected requirements are the fixture the tests load the SRS with. expected_affected_ids are the requirements the impact analysis must list (one hop over findings, a second hop over findings; no embeddings), expected_owners the owners of the target and of everything affected. expected_resolved / expected_new_conflicts / expected_new_duplicates are what the findings delta must report when the classifier answers as the label says (an oracle): they test the delta, not the classifier.

change_requests.proposed_text: The system shall authenticate users with a username and password or a passkey.
change_requests.notes: No impact: REQ-001 has no finding and no owner.

change_requests.proposed_text: API requests shall time out after 10 seconds.
change_requests.notes: Single-requirement impact: aligning the timeout resolves the 2 s vs 10 s conflict.

change_requests.proposed_text: Sessions shall remain active until the user logs out, except admin and guest sessions, which expire after 5 minutes of inactivity.
change_requests.notes: Multi-owner conflict: REQ-032 (Ravi) conflicts with REQ-004 and REQ-020 (Asha); the change resolves both.

change_requests.proposed_text: The system shall store an email address for every user; verifying it is optional.
change_requests.notes: Dependency break: REQ-006 and REQ-027 depend on a verified address; a reset email to an unverified address conflicts with REQ-027's intent.

change_requests.proposed_text: The system shall lock an account after five consecutive failed login attempts.
change_requests.notes: Duplicate introduced: the new text restates REQ-040 (whose duplicate REQ-041 is two steps away); the dependency on REQ-040 no longer holds.

change_requests.proposed_text: Audit log entries shall be retained for ten years.
change_requests.notes: Protected requirement: the conflict with automatic deletion after 12 months still holds; a compliance reviewer must approve.

change_requests.proposed_text: The system shall not display any login history to the user.
change_requests.notes: A duplicate becomes a conflict: REQ-045 still shows the last sign-in.

change_requests.proposed_text: Admin sessions shall expire after 15 minutes of inactivity.
change_requests.notes: Two-hop ripple: REQ-020 is reached through REQ-032's conflict; REQ-004 still conflicts with REQ-032.

change_requests.proposed_text: Administrators shall be able to reset a user's password but never view it.
change_requests.notes: Touches a protected requirement (REQ-028) and resolves the plaintext-password conflict.

change_requests.proposed_text: Retention periods shall be fixed at seven years for every data category.
change_requests.notes: REQ-017 still depends on the retention rule; nothing resolved, nothing new.
